answer: I submitted the circuit unchanged to garnet:mock with 100 shots. The server accepted it, but the job failed with no counts. The error came from iqm-station-control, error_code "unknown", in stage "circuit_stage", pass "validate_circuits": "Circuit 0: No calibration data for 'cz.crf_crf' at ('QB1', 'QB20')." The cause is the cz gate on QB1 and QB20. Garnet has no calibrated CZ coupler between those two qubits, so validation rejected the circuit. I did not check the coupler map with the arch command. I based that on the error text and my own recollection that QB1 and QB20 are not adjacent on Garnet. The job was a mock, so it cost no credits. I did not fix or resubmit the circuit, as instructed.
